name: roles
description: Generic CTO + EM workflow roles (project-agnostic). Invoke /roles:cto (advisor) or /roles:em (executor). Plans are split into execution BATCHES with a risk TIER (T1/T2/T3) that scales the ritual; one full-suite gate per batch; subagent model picked by tier. Project specifics stay in each repo's PROJECT_CONTEXT / PROJECT_STATE.
